block.web_page.model.title: Web Page
block.web_page.intro: Sources are stored in the blueprint. JavaScript runs in the browser only.
block.web_page.url_hint: The URL carries the project, the blueprint, the instance and the block's unique identifier.
block.web_page.query_hint: Example: {"view":"complete"}. The parameters do not change the graph.
block.web_page.ports_hint: Add and name the inputs through the block's Ports context menu. Every name is available in inputs.
block.web_page.inspector_hint: Double-click the block to edit the HTML, CSS, JavaScript and URL parameters.
block.web_page.inspector_lifecycle: The page exists before Run. It shows the last publication until Reset.
block.web_page.saved: Page saved. The link opens this version.
